name: CEARCH
summary: The Centre for Exploratory Altruism Research searches for and funds highly cost-effective ideas in neglected cause areas.

spending.source: No accounts published (a fiscally sponsored project of Players Philanthropy Fund; https://exploratory-altruism.org/about/): our model's judged running costs a year from October 2022 to May 2025, anchored on its incubator's archived profile ($262,000 raised to January 2025, https://web.archive.org/web/20250120145810/https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/centre-for-exploratory-altruism-research) less the money it was given to regrant, all counted as programme.

lines.label: Cause research, grants made and advised, and research commissioned by funders
lines.source: Our model's judged running costs a year, anchored on its incubator's archived profile (https://web.archive.org/web/20250120145810/https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/centre-for-exploratory-altruism-research; grants: https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/k7NjuGEKdRSrrJHmZ/deep-report-on-hypertension?commentId=weQHRcDt53BkCuLct). CEARCH publishes no split by programme: its research, grantmaking and commissioned work are branches of one model. The grants it passes on are money moved, not running costs.
